quick.q: What's most important to tell the AI when writing an email?
options: Who you're writing to and what you want to achieve

quick.q: How do you improve your own text with AI?
options: Paste the text and say what to change
Copy it out by hand 3 times

quick.q: What must AI NOT do in your CV?
Who is responsible for the email you send?
options: You – always read it before sending
The company that makes the AI

options: Read it and check the facts

challenge.task: Your neighbour lent you a drill and you accidentally broke it. Write a prompt to get an apology message.
checklist: What you offer (repair or a new one) and the tone (honest, short)
challenge.example: Write a short, honest apology message to my neighbour. He lent me his drill and I accidentally broke it. Offer to buy a new one or pay for the repair. Max 4 sentences, friendly tone.
